origin.description: Forward or centered difference of a function of several variables.

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Function returning one value or a vector of values.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Point at which the gradient is estimated.

arguments.name: centered
arguments.text: If TRUE, average the forward and backward differences.

arguments.name: pert
arguments.text: Perturbation factor. The step is max(abs(x) * pert, pert).

origin.details: Each variable is perturbed in turn and then restored. Column names are the names of x. Row names are the names of the function value. An unnamed scalar takes the name of the last perturbed variable.
origin.value: A matrix with one row per function value and one column per variable.
origin.example:
f <- function(x) sum(x^2)
x <- c(a = 1, b = 2)
gradient(f, x)
